description: This file defines an abstract class 'MyBaseListFragment' extending 'ListFragment' that manages shortcut-related functionality and system profile broadcasts within an Android application. It handles system interactions such as package and profile changes, permissions, and shortcut updates. The class provides the basic framework for subclasses to implement specific list refresh logic.

classes.name: MyBaseListFragment
classes.description: An abstract fragment class managing shortcut permissions and profile broadcasts, providing hooks for subclasses to implement list updates.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes UserManager and LauncherApps, registers launcher callback.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Logs resume event, shows permission warning if needed, refreshes list, registers broadcast receiver.

methods.name: showPermissionWarningToastWhenNeeded
methods.description: Displays a toast warning if the app lacks shortcut host permission.

methods.name: getAppLabel
methods.description: Retrieves the human-readable application label for a given package, using cached value if available.

methods.name: refreshList
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to refresh displayed data.
